ideas.pitch: A peer-to-peer safety companion app optimized for college campuses featuring real-time route risk assessment and automated check-ins.
ideas.title: HooSafe: Student Safety and Night Escort Coordination Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a universal, high-emotion pain point for university students in Charlottesville, making it instantly relatable to local judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered computer vision web app that identifies recyclable materials via smartphone cameras and awards local campus dining discounts.
ideas.title: HooRecycles: Campus Waste Sorting & Sustainability Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into campus sustainability initiatives, appealing directly to university stakeholders and local zero-waste goals.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent matching platform for university courses that automatically generates collaborative study guides from uploaded lecture audio transcripts.
ideas.title: HooStudy: Peer Study Group Matchmaker with Audio Summarizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, hyper-local problem for students navigating demanding academic semesters at UVa.

ideas.pitch: A budget optimization tool comparing grocery prices across Charlottesville supermarkets to generate affordable weekly student meal plans.
ideas.title: HooBudget: Local Student Grocery Price Comparison & Meal Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers immediate, practical financial utility for college students dealing with inflation and tight budgets.

ideas.pitch: A unified hub aggregating student organization events across campus with QR-code check-ins and personalized interest alerts.
ideas.title: HooEvent: Local Club & Event Discovery Aggregator with RSVP Pass
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly improves fragmented campus social life, offering an application with immediate viral potential among student organizations.
